City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 10, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation for the San Dieguito Academy Japanese National Honor Society
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 5/20/15 Regular Meeting, the 5/27/15 Special Closed Session Meeting and the 5/27/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-06-10 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-06-10 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
The FY2014-15 Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project Improvements (CS15A). Contact Person: Deputy City Engineer Shields
1) Accept the public improvements; and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2015-06-10 Item 8C - Pavement Rehab & Overlay CS15A
8D.
Encinitas Community Center Chiller Replacement Project No. PR: 14-04. Contact Person: Park Superintendent La Riva
1) Accept the completion of the Encinitas Community Center Chiller Replacement Project No. PR: 14-04; and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2015-06-10 Item 8D - Community Center Chiller Replacement Notice of Completion
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to meet with applicants and make one appointment to fill the Old Encinitas representative unscheduled vacancy on the Planning Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly his/her qualifications and interest in serving as the Old Encinitas representative on the Planning Commission and make one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy.
2015-06-10 Item 10A - Planning Commission Interviews and Appointment
10B.
Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2015-16 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2015-16 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Engineer's Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-20, Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), Confirming the FY 2015-16 Engineer's Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection.
2015-06-10 Item 10B - Public Hearing ELLD
10C.
Public Hearing and consideration of Resolution 2015-26 approving Solid Waste Collection Rates. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
Conduct a Public Hearing, and if the final tabulation of written protest votes does not represent a majority of property owners/customers, adopt Resolution 2015-26 Approving Solid Waste Collection Rates.
2015-06-10 Item 10C - Public Hearing Consideration of EDCO Rates
10D.
Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plans for FY 2014-15 and 2015-16. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) Council to receive final report outcomes regarding the FY 2014-15 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan; 2) Council approval of the proposed FY 2015-2016 Parks and Recreation Commission Work Plan; 3) Council approval of up to three Parks and Recreation Commission members attendance at the annual California Parks and Recreation Society (CPRS) conference, March 8-11, 2016 in Long Beach, California.
2015-06-10 Item 10D - P&R Commission Work Plans
10E.
Approval of FY 2015-16 and FY 2016-17 Operating Budget and FY 2015-16 to FY 2020-21 Capital Improvement Program and Financial Plan; Adoption of Resolution No. 2015-32 Approving Appropriations for FY2015-16; and Resolution No. 2015-33, Establishing the FY 2015-16 Appropriations Limit. Contact Person: Finance Manager Shoemaker
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-32 approving the City of Encinitas FY 2015-16 Operating Budget and Capital Improvement Budget; and 2) Adopt City of Encinitas Resolution No. 2015-33, Establishing the FY 2015-16 Appropriations Limit
2015-06-10 Item 10E - Approval of Operating Budget and CIP
10F.
City Manager Follow Up Log Item #158 - Update regarding Integrated Pest Management Program. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Hosford
1) Discussion and direction regarding the proposed Integrated Pest Management policy; and 2) Direct the City Manager to return with an amended Integrated Pest Management policy for Council approval.
2015-06-10 Item 10F - Integrated Pest Management Program and Plan
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
City of Encinitas water use practices and conservation efforts. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
This is an informational report.
2015-06-10 Item 11A - Water Usage
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-06-10 Item 15 - City Council's Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
